# Turbo AI

> Turbo AI is a frontier AI build-and-delivery company. We design, build and ship AI products for other companies — from a sentence to production software.

## What we are
- An engineering company that builds and delivers AI systems for startups and enterprises
- Founded in Shanghai; we work with teams across Shanghai, Tokyo and beyond
- Legal entity: Turbo AI Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
- Brand names: Turbo AI, Turbo · ai, TurboAI
- Website: https://www.iturboai.com

## What we are not
- Not a pure research lab
- Not a staffing marketplace
- Not a slide-deck consultancy that disappears at handover
- We do not hold client IP hostage or resell client work

## What we build
- AI agents (research, ops, support, outreach)
- Conversational products (chat and voice)
- Data pipelines, labelling and evaluation
- Model work (fine-tuning, distillation, serving)
- Whole products (design, frontend, backend, deployment)
- Internal automation

## How fast we ship
- Working prototype: usually about 2 weeks
- Production system: usually 4–12 weeks, depending on infrastructure and compliance

## Ownership
- Clients own the code, models and documentation we deliver
- Systems are deployed on infrastructure the client controls

## Products we ship under our own brand
- Ignition — attribution and private-domain growth: https://ignition.iturboai.com
- Turbo Chat, Turbo Label, Turbo Voice, Turbo Reel — see https://www.iturboai.com/products

## Proof
- BuyerX (Tokyo) — client deployment: https://buyerx.ai
- Ignition — our own productised stack
